samples.question: The tiles in START form a row whose right end is beside the arrow. Read the six ADD cards from left to right; within each card add its left tile, then its right tile. Add each tile to the right end. If it matches the tile currently at the end, those two tiles disappear; otherwise it stays at the end. Which color is at the right end after all six cards? Answer red, green, blue, or yellow.
